title: jasminum simplicifolium subsp. sootepense
intro: Jasminum simplicifolium subsp. sootepense, commonly known as Sootep Jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Thai culture, for its health benefits, which include the potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Sootep Jasmine are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents may help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce the risk of chronic diseases, and promote overall well-being.
